channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the House
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/20/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: HB 1257 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Simmons
item.description: Relating to the right of public employees to collectively bargain with governmental entities.

item.title: HB 1258 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Herbert
item.description: Relating to the creation of the Texas technology and innovation program.

item.title: HB 1259 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Herbert
item.description: Relating to a franchise tax credit for taxable entities that make certain employer child-care contributions.

item.title: HB 1260 Introduced
item.dc:creator: McGee
item.description: Relating to the disclosure of financial interests by and the regulation of advertising by health care practitioners who promote or facilitate the sale of drugs to consumers; providing administrative and civil penalties.

item.title: HB 1261 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Spencer
item.description: Relating to the exercise of eminent domain for a demonstrated public necessity; limiting certain condemnation powers; requiring independent review, public hearings and county elections, enhanced compensation, repurchase rights, and revenue accounting; providing court review, injunctive relief, recovery of costs, and enforcement; contingent in part on a constitutional amendment.

item.title: HB 1262 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Isaac
item.description: Relating to requirements that certain plats for the subdivision of land include evidence of groundwater supply.

item.title: HB 1263 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Ward Johnson
item.description: Relating to notice provided to prospective lessees of residential units on land over a closed municipal solid waste landfill facility.

item.title: HB 1264 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Ward Johnson
item.description: Relating to providing to parents a copy of student emergency procedures included in a public school's multihazard emergency operations plan.

item.title: HB 1265 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Reynolds
item.description: Relating to repealing the education savings account program.

item.title: HB 1266 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Gervin-Hawkins
item.description: Relating to a manufacturer's disclosure of ingredients and toxic metals in lipstick and lip gloss.

item.title: HB 1267 Introduced
item.dc:creator: McGee
item.description: Relating to the exemption from seizure of certain funds held in a deposit account of an individual to satisfy a judgment on a consumer debt and to the protection of the proceeds of current wages.

item.title: HB 1268 Introduced
item.dc:creator: McGee
item.description: Relating to a suit for dissolution of a marriage and associated suit affecting the parent-child relationship when a party is pregnant.

item.title: HB 1269 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Craddick
item.description: Relating to the enforcement of commercial motor vehicle safety standards in certain counties.

item.title: HR 30 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Isaac
item.description: Congratulating the New Braunfels High School girls' cross country team on winning the 2026 UIL 5A state championship.
